description: Returns the "What's New at IC" changelog, newest first, the same list the /whats-new page shows. Without a token you get the public entries. With a token tied to a person you get every entry at or below their membership ring, and the ones unlocked at their ring carry relevant:true ("new for you"). No auth required. Args: { limit?: integer 1-100 }. Returns { ok, tier, signed_in, total, entries: [{ ..., min_tier, relevant }] }.

limit.description: Return at most this many entries, newest first. Default: all of them.

name: ic_whats_new
title: Read what's new at Immersive Commons (public)
